intro: Marvell Technology is acquiring optical-components maker Lumentum for $115 billion, betting on continued AI data-center expansion despite recent market volatility. OpenAI's policy chief outlined five AI policy tests for 2028, warning that a data-center moratorium could parallel major geopolitical decisions, while OpenAI simultaneously signed multiple agreements with Abu Dhabi entities including ADNOC for deploying AI agents in energy operations.
